metadata.title: Services
metadata.description: Premium solar energy solutions and turnkey construction services.

work_process.title: Key Services
work_process.description: Complete engineering, construction and project management in Bulgaria and abroad.
work_process.intro_left: We offer services designed to transform energy projects into secure, efficient, and long-term solutions. Combining real-world experience, technical expertise, and strong organization, we execute every stage with a clear goal – maximum value for the client.
work_process.intro_right: We work quickly, precisely, and responsibly because we know that quality is not just a standard, but a promise. Our team builds photovoltaic installations with sustainability, reliability, and optimal performance in mind, creating partnerships based on trust and results.

steps.ground_desc: We build ground-mounted photovoltaic installations focusing on stability, efficiency, and quality execution, in accordance with applicable international standards and project specifics. Our team ensures precise installation of static and tracker structures and photovoltaic modules, adapted to site conditions, to guarantee maximum performance and long-term system reliability.
steps.rooftop_desc: We implement rooftop solar solutions that turn unused areas into effective energy assets. We work with attention to safety and building specifics to ensure secure operation and high energy return.
steps.carport_desc: We build solar carports that combine functionality with sustainable energy production. These systems provide protection for vehicles while simultaneously generating electricity, adding value to infrastructure and improving site energy efficiency.
steps.floating_desc: We implement floating photovoltaic systems that utilize water surfaces for efficient clean energy production. Our approach ensures platform stability, resistance to external conditions, and optimal performance, expanding opportunities for solar project development.
